title: Application of Image Analysis Technology in Detecting and Diagnosing Liver Tumors
content: We applied processing technology to detect and diagnose liver tumors in patients. The cancer imaging archive (TCIA) was used as it contains images of patients diagnosed with liver tumors by medical experts. These images were analyzed to detect and segment liver tumors using advanced segmentation techniques. Following segmentation, the images were converted into binary images for the automatic detection of the liver’s shape. The tumors within the liver were then localized and measured. By employing these image segmentation techniques, we accurately determined the size of the tumors. The application of medical image processing techniques significantly aids medical experts in identifying liver tumors more efficiently.
